hook: A complete Vim manual, written over four years.
hookText: A Vim manual, four years in the making

beats.say: The author spent almost a decade playing with Vim, and after a couple of hours he could write and edit content, more productively and with more fun.
The book is a step-by-step approach with no less than one hundred seventy fun exercises to build muscle memory, chapter by chapter.
It is aimed at real-life examples, with a rich annexe as a reference, and the author says even long-time Vim users will learn something.
